population.description: 833 adults across five North American sites, spanning voice, neurological, mood and respiratory conditions.
limitations: The PhysioNet distribution carries derived acoustic features and phenotypic data; raw audio is held separately.

failure_reasons: No rapid syllable task is present at all.
No CAPE-V, GRBAS or other multi-rater perceptual judgement is included, and no listener transcription.
Labels are clinical diagnoses and validated participant questionnaires, which are population description and participant report respectively.

inspected_materials: PhysioNet content page for b2ai-voice 3.1.0, read 2026-08-19.
findings: Credentialed access plus a signed data use agreement, and the licence does not state whether commercial use is permitted.
The largest and newest adult voice collection found still supplies neither of the two truth classes item 23 needs.

reasons: No rapid syllable task and no multi-rater perceptual judgement.
Commercial permission is unstated, so rights would also fail closed.
